name: GD 2.1 Physics
description: Restores 2.1 physics & bugs in GD 2.2 so legacy 2.1 levels (e.g. Warcora) are playable again.

enabled.name: Enable 2.1 Physics
enabled.description: Master toggle for the entire mod. When off the game plays exactly like vanilla 2.2.

physics-rate.name: Physics Step Rate
physics-rate.description: fps-locked-21 = 4 substeps per frame like 2.1 (FPS-dependent; reproduces wave clip & ship feel). fixed-240 = 2.2 default 240Hz.

tcbot-compat.name: TCBot / Macro Compatibility
tcbot-compat.description: Forces fixed-240 physics rate so input macros recorded under 2.2 keep working. Behavioural 2.1 fixes (slopes/orbs/pads/wave) stay on.

slope-physics-21.name: 2.1 Slope Physics
slope-physics-21.description: Restores 2.1 slope behaviour (catapulting, no slope-velocity smoothing). Disable to keep stock 2.2 slopes.

orb-priority-21.name: 2.1 Orb / Ring Priority
orb-priority-21.description: Activates orbs in insertion order (the 2.1 way) when several overlap, instead of 2.2's reordered priority.

pad-bug-21.name: 2.1 Pad Bounces
pad-bug-21.description: Restores 2.1 yellow/pink/red pad bounce behaviour, including the famous ball-on-yellow-pad infinite-bounce case.

wave-hitbox-21.name: 2.1 Wave Hitbox
wave-hitbox-21.description: Reverts the wave's hitbox to the slightly-thicker 2.1 version (small effect; mostly visible on small wave).

preserve-21-bugs.name: Preserve Misc 2.1 Bugs
preserve-21-bugs.description: Keeps assorted 2.1 quirks (corner snap, gravity-portal seam, robot-jump frame timing, etc.) — group toggle for the smaller fixes.

log-physics.name: Verbose Physics Log
log-physics.description: Spams the Geode console with per-frame velocity / step-count / slope info. Debug only — do NOT enable for normal play.
